main_hypothesis: A completed-higher-timeframe direction input plus a completed S5/M1 trigger can be evaluated with a fixed gross JPY profit exit and flat-confirmed re-entry without a fixed loss order.

fixed_controls.higher_timeframe: H4 completed bars only; EMA8/EMA21 and close-versus-EMA21 agreement
fixed_controls.entry_units_intent: observed manual units for manual cohort; 5000 only for signal-supply research
fixed_controls.reentry_gate: a fresh read-only broker snapshot must report zero shadow-owned open trade and zero shadow-owned pending order
fixed_controls.costs: entry bid/ask fill, target exit executable side, and a preregistered adverse 10% of touch-bar spread exit slippage
fixed_controls.end_of_replay: never forced-close; mark remaining position to final executable quote and classify unresolved

cohorts.manual_truth: all six prior manual/closeout entries plus the new +560 close; new +560 is labelled overlapping-hedge-context and excluded from concurrency-one clean-success rate
cohorts.signal_supply: frozen 2025 M1 bid/ask files across EUR_USD, USD_JPY, GBP_USD, AUD_USD

rejection_conditions: any result that treats MTM loss as a win
